subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should this issue be resolved by landing the schedule-activation replay fix and tracking emergency stop/delete semantics separately, or should maintainers require one combined fix for replay, cron remove cancellation, and gateway emergency outbound halt?
rationale: The replay bug has a concrete candidate PR, but making cron remove or gateway stop a guaranteed emergency halt changes operator-visible behavior across cron runtime, task cancellation, gateway lifecycle, and channel delivery.

options.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
options.body: Accept the schedule-activation boundary through the existing PR or equivalent replacement, then sponsor a separate product-scoped emergency stop design.

options.title: Require One Combined Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until one implementation covers restart replay, cron remove cancellation, and gateway emergency outbound halt behavior together.

options.title: Narrow To Replay Only
options.body: Treat stop/delete and emergency halt as out of scope for this issue and close only after the replay fix lands.

recommendation.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
recommendation.body: Accept the schedule-activation boundary through the existing PR or equivalent replacement, then sponsor a separate product-scoped emergency stop design.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent direct cron dispatch history and authored schedule-activation ownership/migration commits on the active candidate fix.
